entries.name: literature-page-to-screen
entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: quiet horizontal literary book vignette. Poetic Natural: restrained dark brown-black ink line drawing on genuinely transparent background, generous transparent negative space, sparse selective hand-drawn lines, no paper background or texture wash. A modest open paperback in the foreground, its unlettered page lightly turning and visually leading toward a small cinema screen silhouette farther away; within the screen two simple human figures seen in performance. The metaphor is an invitation from reading to cinema, not a literal historical reconstruction. Wide landscape composition, objects comfortably within edges, no border, no lettering, no logos, no decorative symbols, no photorealism. Keep the book believable and the screen understated; no busy hatching.
entries.visual_assessment: Recognisable open paperback and page-to-screen metaphor; two silhouettes, no readable lettering. Paper interiors retain pale shading, with transparent exterior. More detailed book than a pure outline.

entries.name: preservation-can-and-notes
entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: horizontal book vignette about the patient work of film preservation. Poetic Natural, sparse hand-drawn black-brown ink lines, genuine transparent background with generous empty space; no backdrop wash. A closed intact round metal film can rests beside an open notebook on a plain work surface. Two naturally posed hands: one resting gently on the CLOSED can, the other holding a pencil to record its contents in the notebook. Notebook marks should be sparse abstract short strokes, not readable text; the can's label completely blank. A very faint loosely sketched shelf edge hints at storage. Wide horizontal composition, selective detail on hands and can, unfinished peripheral lines. Do not show bare film, unwound reels, chemical treatment, fictitious historical clothing, faces, archive signage, logos, letters, numbers, borders or photo effects. This is an openly conceptual drawing, not an archival photograph.
entries.visual_assessment: Closed labelled can, intact lid, plausible resting hand and writing grip; no exposed film. More crosshatching and pale interior fills than the sparse-outline ideal, but the recordkeeping action is clear.

entries.review: Inspected generated output at full display; selected.

entries.name: shared-story-table
entries.prompt: Create a MINIMAL OUTLINE ONLY pen drawing with a TRANSPARENT background. Wide horizontal 2:1 composition. Three hands at a small table collaborating: left hand holding pencil to a blank manuscript, upper hand placing a storyboard sheet, right hand pointing at one storyboard frame. THREE hands only. Draw hands, paper outlines and just two short table-edge lines using thin dark-brown ink. The paper has tiny abstract strokes, no words. Storyboard has four simple rectangles with minimal stick figures. EVERYTHING between lines must be transparent. NO shading, NO gradient, NO glow, NO halo, NO colored wash, NO textured background, NO filled surfaces, NO shadows, NO photo effects. Airy sparse quiet Poetic Natural hand-drawn vignette, gentle uneven pen lines. No decorative objects, no border, no text, no logos. It is conceptual art about shared storytelling, not a real event.
entries.visual_assessment: Selected fresh generation removes shaded halo from two rejected versions. Three distinct hands and four storyboard frames are legible; simplified hand contours remain conceptual rather than anatomically detailed. Transparent outline-only treatment suits pale backgrounds.
entries.provenance: New conceptual illustration generated with built-in image_gen; not a documentary image or historical reconstruction; no source photograph or third-party artwork used.
entries.review: Inspected generated output at full display; selected.

rejected_shared_story_versions.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Purpose: wide horizontal vignette accompanying a literary cinema essay about making a story together. Poetic Natural. Restrained black-brown pen line drawing, quiet sparse lines, little hatching, generous genuinely transparent negative space, no rectangle background or frame. Three different human hands around a small ordinary table seen obliquely from above: one writes on a manuscript sheet, another gently places a separate storyboard sheet, the third points toward one of its sketched frames. Exactly three visible hands, credible fingers and grip, unequal natural spacing, practical paper overlap. Paper has only a few abstract short strokes and simple image frames, no readable words or letters. Keep the scene modest and attentive, a conceptual collaboration rather than a specific historical event. No faces, laptop, gears, corporate boardroom, coffee props, logos, decorative symbols, typography, border, or photorealistic finish. Use suggestion rather than exhaustive rendering.

Edit this collaboration illustration only to remove ALL shaded brown/gray background glow, all airbrushing, all filled table surface, all tonal wash and paper texture. Preserve its three natural hands, manuscript, storyboard, gestures and layout. Render these as sparse dark brown ink outlines on completely transparent negative space, like an airy pen drawing. Hands and paper may retain minimal offwhite opaque interiors but no surrounding fog or halo whatsoever. Make the composition a wide horizontal vignette. No text, no logos, no border.
